# vastdata_tls_certificate (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# TLS certificate with CA only (no CRL)
resource "vastdata_tls_certificate" "vastdb_tls_cert" {
  ca_certificate_file = file("path/to/ca.crt")
  ca_certificate_name = "my-ca"
  protocols           = ["NFS"]
}

# TLS certificate with CA and CRL revocation list
resource "vastdata_tls_certificate" "vastdb_tls_cert_with_crl" {
  ca_certificate_file = file("path/to/ca.crt")
  revocation_file     = file("path/to/ca.crl")
  ca_certificate_name = "my-ca-with-crl"
  revocations_name    = "my-crl"
  protocols           = ["NFS", "KAFKA"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ca_certificate_file` (String, Sensitive) CA certificate content (PEM/DER). Uploaded as a file to POST /tlscertificates/.

### Optional

- `ca_certificate_name` (String)
- `ca_certificate_uploaded` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `expires_on` (String)
- `protocols` (Set of String) Protocols for this tls certificate.
- `revocation_file` (String, Sensitive) Certificate Revocation List (CRL) content. When cleared, the CRL is deleted via DELETE /tlscertificates/{id}/crl/.
- `revocations_exist` (Boolean)
- `revocations_expire_on` (String)
- `revocations_name` (String)
- `revocations_uploaded` (String)
- `tenant` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenant))
- `tenant_associate_param` (String)
- `tenant_id` (Number) Tenant ID to associate with the TLS certificate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
